title: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments

sections.title: Fermat's Principle and Reflection at Plane and Spherical Surfaces
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Establish rectilinear ray propagation from Fermat's principle, define Cartesian sign conventions, and analyze image formation by concave and convex spherical mirrors using the mirror formula.
unresolved_gaps: Topic 'reflection-at-spherical-mirrors' lacks approved formula records (mirror formula 1/f = 1/v + 1/u) and canonical question atoms in ChapterSpec.
No worked examples for longitudinal or transverse magnification in spherical mirrors.

sections.title: Refraction at Plane Interfaces and Snell's Law
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Formulate Snell's Law n1 sin(theta1) = n2 sin(theta2), resolve normal incidence behavior (i = 0 implies r = 0, no deviation), and calculate lateral and normal shift through transparent slabs.
source_references: University Physics with Modern Physics, 13th Edition.pdf
unresolved_gaps: No standalone canonical question atom for apparent depth or lateral displacement in plane slabs currently staged.

sections.title: Total Internal Reflection, Relative Critical Angle, and Prism Geometry
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Derive the generalized critical angle condition sin(theta_c) = n_rarer / n_denser for immersed optical components, analyze internal beam deflection in prisms, and resolve misconceptions ignoring surrounding media.

sections.title: Refraction at Spherical Surfaces and Thin Lens Theory
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Derive single spherical surface refraction n2/v - n1/u = (n2 - n1)/R, establish the Lens Maker's formula, and calculate focal length shifts when lenses are immersed in fluids.
source_references: University Physics with Modern Physics, 13th Edition.pdf
unresolved_gaps: Subtopic 'refraction-at-spherical-surfaces-and-lenses' lacks approved formula records (Lens Maker's formula, thin lens equation) and canonical question atoms in ChapterSpec.

sections.title: Compound Optical Instruments: Microscopes and Telescopes
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Analyze compound ray geometry in astronomical and terrestrial telescopes, determine angular magnification in normal adjustment and near-point adjustment, and calculate overall tube length.
unresolved_gaps: Subtopic 'astronomical-and-terrestrial-telescope' lacks approved formula records (m = fo / fe, L = fo + fe) and canonical question atoms in ChapterSpec.

pedagogical_synthesis_notes: Optics Template: Progression flows from plane interface refraction to boundary-trapping phenomena (TIR), prism dispersion geometry, curved refracting surfaces (lenses), and compound multi-element optical instruments.

Relative Index Immersion Invariant: Section 3 tackles misc-opt-01 head-on through ex-opt-tir-prism-water-01 and ray-optics-question-e04c1df3, training students to evaluate the relative refractive index n_rarer / n_denser rather than reflexively setting n_rarer = 1.

Normal Incidence Demystification: Addresses misc-opt-02 across Section 2 and Section 3, establishing that normal incidence (i = 0) produces zero refraction deviation at the first interface, leaving ray redirection purely to internal geometric encounters.
unresolved_gaps: Gap in Topic 'reflection-at-spherical-mirrors': No approved formulas or question atoms in ChapterSpec for concave/convex mirror calculations.
Gap in Topic 'refraction-at-spherical-surfaces-and-lenses': Lens Maker's formula and thin lens combinations lack formula records and question atoms in ChapterSpec.
Gap in Topic 'optical-instruments': Telescopes and microscopes lack canonical question atoms, formulas, and worked examples in current staging.
